item.title: $13,000 And Still No Records
item.description: Dear Editor, Your July 28 article reported that the Turkey Creek Dam & Dike Conservancy District board voted to spend up to $10,000 of taxpayer money with its engineering firm and another $3,000-plus in legal fees, all to respond to routine public records requests. Six months later, the only items produced are PDFs already posted...

item.title: Titus Funeral Home Invites Community To Holiday Remembrance Service
item.description: Titus Funeral Home & Cremation Services is inviting families throughout the community to attend its annual Holiday Remembrance Service, a gathering created to bring comfort, hope and connection to those grieving the loss of a loved one.

item.title: Carmel City Council Passes Micromobility Ordinance
item.description: The Carmel City council passed new regulation regarding the use of electric bikes, scooters and other micromobility options at its Monday, Nov. 17 meeting.

item.title: Atwood Business Donates Tree to Nappanee Tree Lighting Ceremony
item.description: Blue Skies Renovations in Atwood has offered their large pine tree to the town of Nappanee for their downtown tree and lighting ceremony.

item.title: Whitestown Man Faces Manslaughter Charges Following Fatal Porch Shooting
item.description: A Whitestown man is being held without bond on a voluntary manslaughter charge in the fatal shooting of a housekeeper who mistakenly approached his home before dawn on Wednesday, Nov. 5.
